name: Canvas status
summary: The status line on a slide canvas (Waiting for answers…) as one component: free-floating deck text, no fill on any deck.
highlights: Free-floating text in the deck ink, no backing even on photo decks
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-canvas-status> — for the waiting state many slide types show on the presenter canvas before the result: a status line in the deck ink at 76%. It carries no fill or stroke, so it sits straight on the deck, a photo deck included. The text is an attribute; pass a translated string in the product. The number of responses is not part of it.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks. Attributes only, no events.

spec.label: Status line
spec.value: 18px / 400 (the canvas body size), --aha-deck-ink-secondary (the deck ink at 76%); `text=""` hides it

spec.label: Backing
spec.value: none on every deck — never a fill, stroke or scrim, photo decks included

props.name: text
props.desc: The status line; an empty string hides it

whenToUse.when: while answers come in on the presenter canvas: what is happening
once there is a result to count: correct / incorrect, or answered next to the result

opinion.note: Keep it to the line. It is text on the deck, so never put it in a card or behind a scrim: on a photo deck the deck's own text treatment carries it, as it carries the slide title.

a11y.note: Updates change the text of a persistent node, so a screen reader hears each new line once and nothing is re-announced on unrelated renders.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The probe sits on a white stage with no deck applied, so every value is its DS fallback.
